# cubing.js display adaptation

Cube3D.ts is the sole adapted upstream source file in this bundle. It is supplied under MPL-2.0, matching the bundled LICENSE-MPL.md. Only its six face materials were recolored for the scanner's physical color arrangement. All move logic remains unchanged.

The complete unmodified source snapshot is preserved in the sibling cubing.js checkout at commit bd472ae4d47e72ec263dcbe7005214f7f3946bb5, and is available from https://github.com/amanalex2006/cubing.js/tree/bd472ae4d47e72ec263dcbe7005214f7f3946bb5.

Rebuild with npm ci --prefix viewer followed by node scripts/build_viewer.mjs. The adaptation itself is recorded in that script.
